source_decisions.shopify: Keep as the broad commerce and discovery layer. A focused merchant census found six additional native MODEL_3D products, including textured sofas. Country-level Spain joins are verified without disclosing the project postcode during bulk discovery. The same merchant was exhaustively checked for 604 coffee tables, 385 side tables, 121 floor lamps and 212 rugs with zero native-3D hits, so this source's native geometry lane is closed for those roles.
source_decisions.woocommerce: Adapter remains live, but current non-demo inventory is industrial lighting and is excluded from the residential room until a real residential merchant is discovered.
source_decisions.mirakl_multichannel: The Leroy Merlin/ADEO Mirakl seller API and BeezUP, Koongo, Poleepo and Oceges routes are documented seller-side systems. They are not buyer access to the complete marketplace, but they create a strong supplier-onboarding and outbound-syndication lane: Product Twin can enrich authorized supplier records with identity, media evidence, scored avatars and AI-readable attributes, publish them across Mirakl channels, then ingest the supplier's dated offers, stock, orders and shipment events. BigBuy remains independently unverified and no credentialed seller test has run.
source_decisions.manufacturer_geometry: Continue automated public/gated source resolution already represented in the repository; exact assets remain rights- and material-gated.
source_decisions.avatar_factory: Use the eight promoted G2 Product Twins to design and test the room now while deeper avatars are promoted independently. The new evidence factory scores identity, dimensions, view coverage, image quality, material evidence, geometry prior and rights separately; five audited Shopify seating kits are strong P2 inputs, two are usable with limits and one is P1-only. Public generation remains gated by reconstruction/render rights and post-generation QA.
source_decisions.product_twin_readiness: The avatar score is now joined back to the full Product Twin graph: identity, selected configuration, geometry, dimensions/fit, technical evidence, rights, supplier/offer, Spain/postcode delivery, logistics/landed cost, procurement route and attribution. Eight exact merchant offers have dated prices and availability; all eight are Spain catalogue candidates, two passed postcode-level catalogue filtering, but none has authoritative checkout delivery, Spanish supplier/dispatch-origin proof, lead time, landed cost or procurement-ready state.
source_decisions.design_supply_coverage: The eight placed living-room Twins now produce client-specific coverage by line item and quantity, with geography and delivery time kept separate. A live IKEA Spain check for postcode 29660 confirms seven of eight exact room products as destination-deliverable with a four-to-seven-day combined-cart window; LISTERBY is confirmed unavailable. Supplier or dispatch origin remains unresolved for all eight. VALNÄS now has an exact identity, live destination offer and verified-scale G2 planning avatar, but it does not count as confirmed coverage until the changed footprint/height and client approval gates pass. The same room is benchmarked independently against Spain, Sweden, the UK and the USA.
source_decisions.local_anchor_network: Each benchmark market must connect at least one home/furniture, building-materials, trade/MEP and manufacturer-BIM/identity route. Candidate retailers are research targets, not assumed API access. Spain is currently partial; supplier email outreach remains parked.
